items.title: Why Has McDonald's Gone Quiet On Its Low-Income Customer?
items.summary: McDonald's (MCD) stock fell 14.2% over the past 12 months, versus roughly 14.3% for the S&P 500, and now sits near its 52-week low. Over roughly the same stretch, management changed how it explains weak traffic. It used to point at customers outside its control. It now points at its own restaurants, and that makes the stock a different bet.

items.title: MCD Stock Fades After 0.7% Pop On Value-Menu Revamp Report
items.summary: McDonald’s told franchisees it will spend the coming weeks building a “longer-term” value plan aimed at price-sensitive customers, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: McDonald’s said to plan value strategy overhaul to revive US sales growth
items.summary: Investing.com -- McDonald’s Corp. is developing a new value strategy with franchisees after posting its weakest US sales growth in over a year, Bloomberg reported on Thursday.

items.title: McDonald’s CEO Admits Execution Failure as K-Shape Economy Splits Consumer Base
items.summary: McDonald's is supposed to be the stock that holds up when consumers fall apart, so why is it trading like the crisis is already here while retail spending hits record highs? The answer exposes a fracture in the American consumer that most portfolios are not priced for.

items.title: One of These 3 Companies Is One Year From Becoming a Dividend King. Here Is Which One
items.summary: Three longtime Dividend Aristocrats are closing in on a milestone only a handful of US companies have ever reached, but only one of them is genuinely standing on the doorstep of joining the most exclusive income-investing club in the market.

items.title: Chili’s Gearing Up for Battle With Taco Bell
items.summary: Chili’s went after fast-food burgers, and now it wants to take a bite out of to-go Mexican. Executives from Chili’s parent Brinker International said Thursday that the chain plans on developing new spins on tacos and quesadillas.

items.title: BROS Trades at 38.45X P/E: Should Investors Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: Dutch Bros' growth is supported by shop expansion, digital adoption and higher 2026 guidance, but its premium valuation and rising costs add risk.

items.title: Can Starbucks' 600-650 New Stores Strengthen Its Global Growth?
items.summary: SBUX plans 600-650 net new stores in fiscal 2026, leaning on international growth, licensing and disciplined development to expand globally.
